summary: Aggregate a GeoZarr dataset within each feature of a feature collection

parameters.name: dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the published GeoZarr collection to aggregate (as listed under /datasets).

parameters.name: temporal_extent
parameters.description: Time range to load as [start, end] ISO-8601 date strings.

parameters.name: geometries
parameters.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection to aggregate within. Each feature's `id` identifies its row in the result.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: Spatial aggregation method applied to the pixels within each feature: mean (default), min, max, sum, or median.
